name: Quality Gate Closure Infrastructure for Programming Artifact Evidence
description: Connect artifact prompt extraction to the existing quality-gates-system and quality-ledger infrastructure by resolving quality-status records into GateDescriptor evidence, adding explicit ledger fallback, and supporting opt-in freshness SLA without changing registry-service, index-meta, or ontology allocation lifecycle.

userStories.title: Extract shared quality gate topology helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want quality gate topology resolution to be shared between quality export and artifact extraction so that both paths use the same definition graph semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract reusable CLI-internal helper(s) from the existing quality.ts graph traversal path
The helper traverses definition-catalog contains links the same way quality export currently does
The helper can collect contained docs for a root or bundle id
The helper can convert collected gate docs into GateDescriptor[]
The helper preserves existing quality export behavior
No public package API is introduced unless required by implementation
The helper does not read registry-service or index-meta

userStories.title: Resolve quality-status refs into quality gate descriptors
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want artifact quality-status records to resolve into existing quality gate descriptors so that prompt extraction can reuse the quality gate infrastructure.
acceptanceCriteria: Add descriptor resolution for matched quality-status records in artifact extraction

Descriptor resolver input priority is loaded snapshot rootId plus bundleIds, then quality-status metadata.rootId plus metadata.bundles[].bundleId, then record.verifiesRefs and record.materializesOutputRefs, then record.verificationRefs when they point directly to gate docs, then relations with verifies or materializes_output
Root/system refs and bundle refs are resolved through the definition graph
Bundle refs resolve to all contained gate docs
Direct gate refs resolve to that gate doc only
The resulting descriptors include gateDocId, docVersion, and bundleId
docVersion is taken from the same quality doc index path used by quality export
If only scan data is available and version fallback is required, use the existing quality export behavior rather than inventing a new version policy
If no gate descriptors can be resolved, emit structured warning code quality-status-ledger-no-gate-descriptors

userStories.title: Add explicit quality-ledger fallback input
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want artifact extraction to use quality-ledger only when explicitly requested so that local DB state does not become a hidden dependency.
acceptanceCriteria: qa-sdk ontology prompt extract-artifact accepts --quality-ledger <path>
When --quality-ledger is absent, existing snapshot-only behavior is unchanged
A provided but missing ledger path emits quality-status-ledger-missing
A provided but unreadable or corrupt ledger path emits quality-status-ledger-read-failed
Ledger failures do not crash prompt extraction
The flag affects only artifact extraction paths that process related quality-status evidence
Non-artifact prompt extraction commands remain unchanged

userStories.title: Load snapshot-first ledger fallback evidence
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want valid quality export snapshots to remain the primary evidence source, with quality-ledger used only as a fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: A valid quality-status.outputPath snapshot remains the primary closure evidence
Ledger fallback is attempted only when snapshot evidence is missing, invalid, incomplete, or has no verified bundle/gate surface
Ledger fallback calls existing QualityLedger.resolveBundleVerification() with resolved gate descriptors
Ledger-derived evidence includes bundle id, total gates, verified gates, blocking gate statuses, gate refs, and latest run timestamps when available
Ledger fallback never downgrades a valid verified snapshot
Snapshot/ledger conflict is narrowly defined as both snapshot and ledger are available for the same resolved bundle/gate surface, both claim a determinate verification state, and the states disagree
Snapshot/ledger conflict emits quality-status-ledger-conflict
If snapshot is verified and ledger exists but is older, missing, or not explicitly used as fallback, snapshot remains authoritative
Ledger evidence with unresolved descriptors emits quality-status-ledger-no-gate-descriptors

userStories.title: Surface ledger fallback evidence in extract-artifact JSON
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want extract-artifact --json to show whether governance closure came from snapshot or ledger fallback evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: source.qualityStatusRecords.records[] includes qualityLedgerEvidence when ledger fallback is used
qualityLedgerEvidence includes ledger path, bundle ids, gate refs, verified gate count, total gate count, blocking gates, and timestamp summary
source.qualityStatusRecords.warnings[] includes stable machine-readable ledger warning objects
source.warnings[] includes the corresponding warning codes

Stable ledger warning codes are quality-status-ledger-missing, quality-status-ledger-read-failed, quality-status-ledger-no-gate-descriptors, quality-status-ledger-incomplete, and quality-status-ledger-conflict
source.governanceClosure.status continues to use only quality-status-found, quality-status-missing, quality-status-invalid, and quality-status-incomplete
Search fallback warnings remain under source.qualitySignal.warning, not source.governanceClosure.warning

userStories.title: Add opt-in quality-status freshness SLA
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want old quality-status evidence to become stale only when an explicit max age policy is provided.
acceptanceCriteria: qa-sdk ontology prompt extract-artifact accepts --quality-status-max-age-days <n>
When the flag is absent, existing generatedAt behavior is unchanged
Invalid max-age values fail with a clear CLI error
Snapshot evidence uses snapshot generatedAt for freshness checks
Ledger fallback freshness uses BundleVerification.gateStatuses[*].lastRun.executedAt
Ledger freshness uses the oldest relevant verified gate executedAt timestamp
If any required verified gate is older than the threshold, the evidence outcome is stale
If required gate timestamps are unavailable, the evidence is incomplete, not stale
Stale evidence emits prompt-quality-status-evidence-stale and does not improve governance_closure
JSON warning code quality-status-generated-at-stale is emitted for stale freshness policy failures

userStories.title: Propagate ledger and stale outcomes into prompt quality
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want prompt quality scoring to treat ledger-derived and stale quality-status evidence consistently with snapshot-derived evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Ledger-derived verified evidence is converted into existing PromptArtifactQualityStatusEvidence
Verified ledger evidence can improve governance_closure only when it verifies the target and has verified bundle/gate surface
Failed, stale, invalid, incomplete, target-mismatch, descriptor-missing, and conflict evidence does not improve governance_closure
Existing ready, usable, and degraded quality bands remain stable except for explicit ledger/freshness inputs
Mixed verified and invalid/stale/conflict evidence keeps governance closure open unless all required target evidence is verified and fresh
Existing non-artifact prompt quality behavior remains backward compatible
